mapper.update: UPDATE product p1 SET p1.is_deleted = 0 WHERE p1.id = #{id} AND p1.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND p1.is_deleted != 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT product_name, merchant_id FROM product WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}) p2 WHERE p2.product_name = p1.product_name AND p2.merchant_id = p1.merchant_id )
